types.label: Build signed in to Claude
types.description: A build started on a Claude account: the token it uses was checked with Anthropic (which account, which build, verified OK, renewing, or not answered).

types.label: Claude token refreshed and saved
types.description: A Claude login renewed its token: the new token was saved to the account's shared login file and every store, and read back OK.

types.label: Build could NOT sign in to Claude
types.description: Anthropic refused the token a build was about to use (which account, which build, the HTTP answer). The build will stop on it until the account signs in again.

types.label: Claude token refresh NOT saved
types.description: A Claude login renewed its token but the new token could not be written back or read back from the shared login file: builds on that account may stop at their next renewal.
